40:t_008:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Too bad...! I had that position figured.」

40:t_009:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「An ambush in a place like this...!?」

40:t_009:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I didn't spend three months drilling the interception unit for nothing, you know.」

40:t_009:3.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「We won't make it in time!」

40:t_010:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Our atmospheric entry angle is off! If this keeps up...!」

40:t_011:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ is...!」

40:t_011:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Hurry and recover all units! The $$マクロス・クォーター$$ is entering the atmosphere too!」

40:t_012:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If they descend in that attitude, the friction heat from the air will make that ship go boom, I'd say.」

40:t_012:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... a mothership going boom. Even I think that's a terrible pun.」

40:t_012:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... that completes our minimum mission. Let's leave the rest to $$ギルター$$.」

40:t_013:0.en:
$$アル$$
「Not bad, Sergeant. Keep this up, tear them apart and toss them aside one after another, and get this over with fast!」

40:t_013:2.en:
$$アル$$
「What kind of vague answer is that!? You've got to put some more BAM into your fighting spirit!」

40:t_013:4.en:
$$アル$$
「Yes, I used Miss $$千鳥$$ as a reference. To understand you, Sergeant, this is the result of asking her to be my adviser, as the most effective method.」

40:t_013:7.en:
$$アル$$
「I am having trouble understanding. I judged that this tone is the one that motivates you, Sergeant, the most.」

40:t_013:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you claim to be high-performance, be original instead of imitating other people!」

40:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Al, what were you talking about with $$千鳥$$ before the sortie?」

40:t_100:3.en:
$$アル$$
「I was only searching, in my own way, for methods to improve efficiency in combat.」

40:t_100:4.en:
$$アル$$
「In due time, I will be able to show you the results as well, Sergeant.」

40:t_100:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you say that much, I'll look forward to it.」

40:t_101:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hoho... so young. Even just by the way you fly, your freshness shows through.」

40:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「This guy...! He talks like a clown, but he's skilled!」

40:t_101:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha ha, I get told that a lot. ...Not that I intend to fix it.」

40:t_101:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then I'll shut you up myself!」

40:t_101:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Thank you for going out of your way to answer my banter. That's exactly the sort of thing youth does.」

40:t_102:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「This guy's machine...! It's in a different class from the other mass-production units!」

40:t_102:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, I am the commander. They let me ride something suitable.」

40:t_102:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But I'd say your machine, since you put it that way, is quite a fine piece as well.」

40:t_102:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Being praised by an enemy doesn't make me happy at all!」

40:t_102:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You say that, yet a smile slips out. That's youth for you. Well then, allow me to cross swords with you!」

40:t_103:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「What a rare type of machine this is... It's truly a machine unique to Earth.」

40:t_103:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Are you talking about the $$アーバレスト$$?」

40:t_103:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That such machines can be built must be what makes the planet Earth so unique...」

40:t_103:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't know what you're talking about, but right now I'm carrying out my mission...!」

40:t_103:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That single-mindedness... truly the privilege of the young.」

40:t_104:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's go, old man! Don't think you can stop us!」

40:t_104:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, well... Even among all you young people, this one is exceptionally young.」

40:t_104:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you take us lightly because you think we're kids, you'll regret it!!」

40:t_104:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... even I didn't expect this. Young... far too young!」

40:t_105:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Go, $$鉄人$$! Take out their commander!」

40:t_105:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha ha, amusing yourself by playing with dolls... That's not so much young as still a child.」

40:t_105:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I see through your scheme. You're trying to throw us off our pace and make us angry on purpose, aren't you!」

40:t_105:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh my... it seems this boy knows the underside of society and how dirty adults can be.」

40:t_105:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「In that case, there's nothing for it but to hold you down by force. Allow me to show you the power of an adult.」

40:t_106:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hoho... so you're the new $$スフィア・リアクター$$ I've heard about.」

40:t_106:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「No, it's just... believe it or not, I've had quite a connection with Reactors...」

40:t_106:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As wide as the galaxy is, I may be the only person who has actually met this many Reactors.」

40:t_106:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, how scary. Youth that knows no fear is a frightening thing.」

40:t_106:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But you don't seem to have mastered the $$スフィア$$ at all yet. That's a relief.」

40:t_106:7.en:
$n
「I don't care about the power of the $$スフィア$$...! I'll just keep fighting with this $$ジェニオン$$!」
